method_notes: Harrow community school admission arrangements 2027/28, Part C (Definitions - Distance): distance measured in a straight line from home to school using a computerised mapping system based on Ordnance Survey data, from the unique address point of the home address to the centre point of the school site (council publishes maps of each school's centre point). Part A(ii) oversubscription criteria end with distance; tie-breaker within any criterion is straight-line distance, and equidistant applicants are separated by random computer selection. Primary Schools Guide 2025/26 states Harrow schools have no catchment areas and 'all schools in Harrow measure distances from home to school in a straight line from the home address to the school', usually to the centre point of the school (but it can be different in some cases). Council tables give furthest distance in miles where the distance criterion was applied as a tie-breaker; 'N/A' means distance was not needed. Faith VA schools, Catholic/CofE academies, Hujjat and St Jérôme (free schools) are reported only as 'contact the school'. Avanti House and Krishna Avanti (Hindu faith academies) are reported in full, with faith quotas before distance.

gaps: Council tables do not give a distance for the nine faith/free schools (Hujjat, St Anselm's, St Bernadette's, St George's, St Jérôme, St John Fisher, St John's CofE, St Joseph's, St Teresa's): marked not_published where all places were filled, and all_offered (inferred, not stated) where fewer offers than places were made or extra children were placed there as nearest school with a vacancy. School policies for these were not read. Own-admission-authority schools (academies, VA, free schools) are assumed straight line per the guide's blanket statement; exact measuring points not verified. The Avanti House and Krishna Avanti policy PDFs on avanti.org.uk returned an HTML page to plain curl and were not read. 'all_offered' for community/academy schools is inferred from 'N/A' in the furthest-distance column (distance not used as tie-breaker); totals sometimes include children placed as 'nearest school with a vacancy'. Grange 2024 table shows 90 places with only 60 offered yet a 1.285-mile cut-off, recorded as printed. Longfield PAN is 90 in all three tables but 60 in the 2025/26 guide; PAN taken from the 2026 table. Postcodes and types come from the 2025/26 council guide (not GIAS-verified); a newer guide was not used. Moriah Jewish Day School (Pinner) is not in the council guide or allocation tables and was not included. Kenmore Park Junior (Year 3 intake) excluded.
